lines.text: Every family has one person who knows all the stories.
None of it is written down.
We all mean to ask. Then life gets busy.

lines.speaker: A Story
lines.text: Who did you meet by pure chance who changed your life?
She just talks. She never types.

lines.speaker: A Story
lines.text: Did you know where they came from?
Every answer becomes a memory, in her own words.
The whole family adds what they remember.
And whenever you're ready, it becomes a book you can hold.
Grandma gets a call she looks forward to.
The family hears stories they've never heard.
And her stories become a book the whole family keeps.
A Story. Your family's living memories.
